notes.text: The page is headed SGA 4 VI and Sommaire. The first four item ranges are 1 à 19, 20 à 37, 38 à 46 and 47 à 65. No date is visible. These are source observations, not pagination independently verified elsewhere.
notes.basis: Top heading, items 1–4 and right margin.

notes.text: Original Constructibilité is cancelled; a handwritten replacement concerns finiteness for a topos obtained by recollement, with obtenu par inserted separately. Original item 9 receives a 5 and is circled, with a long curve and actual question mark leading up to the divider below item 4. The question belongs to editing/order, not to a named mathematical proof.

The handwritten Appendix is attributed on the page to P. Deligne. After a struck Existence de points, the rewritten wording appears to say Un topos cohérent a suffisamment de points. The d’/Un boundary and a remain doubtful. The source wording is recorded without proving the assertion.
notes.basis: Handwritten item 10, crop 14; observation with explicit reading uncertainty.

notes.text: The cancelled NB discusses interchanging numbered sections and prefers two consecutive sections for the two aspects of passage to a limit in cohomology; it says the section numbered 8 would be reduced to one or two pages. The first bloc bound visibly has typed 5 replaced by handwritten 4, regardless of which ordering would be mathematically or editorially expected.
notes.basis: Cancelled NB paragraph, especially crop 15; observation, no proof inference.

notes.text: The second cancelled paragraph proposes constructible groups, torsion sheaves, and constructibility for Modules and complexes, including the locally noetherian case. Je pense que je le rédigerai mais ne le garantis pas is a drafting intention, not a proved mathematical claim.

The final typed paragraph calls the rédaction of sections 1–3 àomplète as actually typed, and proposes further examples. A typed example of a noncoherent morphism of coherent topoi is separately cancelled; the bottom insertion names a topos with a generating family of coherent objects that is not locally algebraic. The final plural s of objet(s) remains uncertain.
notes.basis: Lower paragraph 3 and bottom insertion; observation.

notes.text: Long pencil cancellation strokes visibly traverse all three lower typed paragraphs. The bottom handwritten insertion is transcribed live as in both witnesses, but the overlapping pencil grid does not establish the relative chronology of cancellation and addition. Pencil hand attribution is not independently established; inventory uses another unnamed hand for such marks.
notes.basis: Whole layout and half b; observation plus explicit attribution/chronology limit.

notes.text: No mathematical checking occurred in this reader run. There are no targeted proof checks, re-proofs or computations. The only mathematical notation requiring inspection is capital-L Lim with its handwritten right-pointing arrow.
notes.basis: Complete reader run; check_events intentionally empty.
